messages:
Samir: quick question — for audit exports, can we add a compact 'actor_rollup' object per change event instead of embedding full actor profiles? size is getting huge in NDJSON dumps.
Anika: yeah this came up in the console perf spikes. We have many tiny changes and the download ballooned.
Marco: curious — do you mean a canonical id + display hints, or a full mapping block at the top of the export?
Samir: thinking canonical id + minimal hints inline, then a separate `actors` chunk (optional) that consumers can request. default export surface should be compact.
Elaine: must ensure legal/personal-data controls — some customers want hashed actor ids, others full email. We need export-level policy flags: pii_mode = {raw, pseudonymized, hashed}.
Maya: agreed. Also telemetry: if we compact, we lose immediate actor counts for UI. We should emit a small metrics row per file with actor_summary counts (unique_actors, privileged_actor_count).
Anika: sample NDJSON idea:
```
{"ts":"2026-03-19T12:01:01Z","event":"route.change","actor_rollup":{"id":"a_123","name_hint":"A. Chen","role":"admin"},"diff":"..."}
{"ts":"2026-03-19T12:02:03Z","event":"route.change","actor_rollup":{"id":"a_124","name_hint":"S. Patel","role":"engineer"},"diff":"..."}
```
Samir: exactly. Then optionally append `actors.ndjson` with full profiles. Consumers that need join can stream it.
audit-bot: export prepared: size=1.2MB entries=420 actors=37
Marco: API side debate — should internal export API accept `actor_mode=compact|expanded` or should Console decide and post-process? If we do it in API, we can enforce quotas and soft-fail earlier.
Anika: prefer API flag. Console can default to compact to protect perf and bandwidth. Also allow `include_actor_index=true` to append the actors block.
Elaine: rollout UX: non-admin users should see a blurred actor hint in the UI unless they have permission. For exports, respect the export owner's privilege. We need an audit trace showing who exported with which pii_mode.
Maya: telemetry hooks: emit a telemetry event for export_start/export_complete with fields: format (ndjson), actor_mode, actors_count, export_duration_ms, sampling_rate if applied. These are useful for quota pricing too.
Samir: quotas — compact exports can count as 1 unit per 1k events, expanded counts more. Need to coordinate with billing team.
Marco: implementation note: keep the actor_rollup schema stable: id (string), name_hint (string, optional), role (string, optional), pseudonym_hash (string, optional). No nested objects beyond that.
Anika: also add a `change_digest` field we can use for deduping in downstream SIEMs.
Elaine: on PII redaction: add `pii_mode` metadata at top of file plus per-event `pii_overrides` if an event has different masking.
Samir: can we have a mechanism to retroactively expand compact exports via a server-side join? e.g., POST /exports/{id}/resolve-actors -> returns actors.ndjson fetched lazily.
Marco: feasible but watch auth surface. Caller must be same org and have `export:read` + `actor:resolve` scopes.
Maya: small ask — include a `metrics.json` manifest adjacent to the NDJSON bundle with counts and top-10 actors (anonymized hash) so quick dashboards can render without scanning the whole dump.
Anika: UX note: Console export page should show a toggle and an inline estimate: "Compact export ~120KB; Expanded ~2.4MB" to make choices clear.
Samir: ok action items: 1) Anika to spec API flags and console microcopy, 2) Marco to prototype server-side actor index append, 3) Elaine to write PII policy matrix and required audit trace, 4) Maya to spec telemetry metrics/events.
Anika: I'll drop a rough API spec in #eng-platform later today.
Marco: I'll start a small spike branch for `actor_index` as a separate CDN artifact.
Elaine: I'll add compliance notes to the export schema doc and list required fields for legal review.
Maya: will add telemetry fields and initial Dashboard estimation query.
Samir: thanks all — feel free to ping me if you want to sync.
Anika: tagging @Samir for follow-up when spec is up :eyes:"
